inputs.name: fit
inputs.cite: C2b q1, q2 (relayed; data not held)

day.reading: k has been 0.5 mu or less; it never reaches mu because d never reaches 1; selection at d = 0.08 is negligible
day.note: the Delta-p arithmetic holds; the fit itself cannot be checked (24 points not held)

critic.reading: the line, extrapolated, gives k = 0.102 mu at d = 1 and needs d = -1.013 for k = mu
critic.note: the slope is negative, so on the fit k approaches mu as d falls below 0, not as d rises to 1; 'd never reaches 1' does not bear on k reaching mu

notes: Every consequence in the statement reproduces from the printed line: k = 0 -> d = 1.229, d = 1 -> k = 0.102 mu, k = mu -> d = -1.013, k = 0.5 mu -> d = 0.108; r = -0.991 and R^2 = 0.981 agree within rounding; Delta-p = 7.92e-6. The data and fit are secondhand and not held, so the record checks implications only. Whether d = 1 is the discrete-generation case is C2a (M-107).
